personas.name: Ali Raza
personas.goal: Sneaker collection + wishlist on every shelf
personas.headline: How Ali finally knew what he owned
personas.summary: Ali photographs pairs on phone, browses the shelf on iPad, and plans wishlist buys on laptop.

day.title: Shelf on phone
day.text: Ali opens the collection on his phone while a box sits on the bed — finally matching what he owns to what he remembers owning.

day.title: Detail photos
day.text: A quick phone photo attaches to a pair’s detail page so the shelf and the under-bed storage stop arguing.

day.title: iPad shelf map
day.text: Wider shelf map on the iPad shows gaps and doubles; he laughs at two identical colourways he swore were unique.

day.title: Wishlist laptop
day.text: Laptop wishlist before payday — wants, not cart panic — with notes on size and why he wants them.

day.title: Stats glance
day.text: Laptop stats show fictional counts only; he closes the lid knowing the shelf finally matches the boxes.

video.transcript: Ali catalogues on phone, reviews on iPad, plans on laptop. Fictional.

personas.quote: The shelf matches the box under the bed.

personas.name: Fatima Hassan
personas.goal: Kids’ book shelves she can tidy weekly
personas.headline: How Fatima keeps the kids’ shelves honest
personas.summary: Fatima logs books on phone, sorts shelves on iPad with the kids, plans donations on laptop.

day.title: Scan a spine
day.text: During breakfast tidy Fatima adds a spine on her phone so the kids’ shelves stop lying about what is already owned.

day.title: Kids on iPad
day.text: After school the iPad shelf is a game: they point at favourites, she marks duplicates before the next book fair.

day.title: Donation list
day.text: Laptop donation list for the weekend drop — titles leaving the house on purpose, not vanishing into a car boot.

day.title: Wishlist trim
day.text: Wishlist trimmed on the laptop so the next buy is intentional, not a double of something under the bed.

day.title: Phone lock
day.text: Phone confirms tonight’s adds before she locks the screen and calls it a weekly win.

personas.name: George Whitfield

day.title: Sleeve photo
day.text: George photographs a sleeve on his phone and adds a condition note that will travel with the record, not live in his head.

day.title: iPad browse
day.text: Afternoon iPad browse through the collection feels like standing at the shelves without kneeling on the floor.

day.title: Laptop inventory
day.text: Laptop inventory for insurance — full list current, fictional values illustrative, no spreadsheet from 2011.

day.title: Wishlist pressings
day.text: Wishlist of pressings on the laptop; he wants fewer impulse buys and better notes when he finds one.

day.title: Phone end
day.text: Phone confirms today’s adds. The note finally travels with the sleeve.
